protocol_preflight.review_type: protocol preflight, not a model experiment
protocol_preflight.hypothesis: A full-footprint positive registry raster makes the literal 3-pixel forward-overlap gate impossible for every nonempty in-footprint candidate.
protocol_preflight.mechanism: Every permitted dot lies on positive witness support, hence within 3 pixels of it; forward overlap is exactly one.
protocol_preflight.non_fault_process: Continuous probability support is a raster representation, not evidence of a physical fault at every pixel.
protocol_preflight.holdout_note: No new HOLDOUT-DTI experiment; no organizer receipt; no score projection.

correlation_overlap_vs_registry.implication: Every nonempty candidate dot set in the allowed domain has forward overlap 1.0 with this prior; therefore it cannot pass the 0.70 gate.

protocol_preflight.submission_note: DO NOT SUBMIT: literal registry gate blocks every nonempty candidate; no new raster generated.
reasons: No single method paragraph was assigned in the current request.
Literal forward-overlap gate is unsatisfiable for any nonempty allowed prediction: registry witness covers every allowed cell.
protocol_preflight.scope: One verified counterexample is enough to prove impossibility. This is NOT a complete registry inventory or a new score-surface audit.
protocol_preflight.required_resolution: An explicit revised registry representation policy and an assigned method lane are needed. Do not exclude continuous rasters silently. Slot selection remains separate.

hypothesis: Blind faults retain a contrast-invariant multi-scale local-phase step (monogenic phase congruency) even where gradient amplitude is too weak for HGM/tilt/worm detectors and for catalogue mapping.
mechanism: Riesz-transform monogenic signal on RTP / isostatic gravity / detrended elevation / depth-to-basement; DoG scales sigma=1,2,4 px; per-source phase congruency + 3 amplitudes + mean-phase cos/sin + orientation coherence (+Frangi bright/dark on RTP & det-elev) = 32 MPC-family features added to a 48-band geophysics+topo+lidar+radiometric stack (80 total); leave-one-quadrant-out HistGradientBoosting on visible catalogue only (negatives EDT>3px, 4:1); spaced greedy emission (min_dist 2.5 px) to exactly 37,654 dots at EDT(catalogue)>2.5 px (min realised 2.83 px).
non_fault_mimic: Lithologic contacts and aeromagnetic flight-line levelling seams are also phase-coherent step edges; they can mimic fault phase congruency with no fault present.
